svg.aria-label: Beyond the core, the cache hierarchy and memory
svg.text: Beyond the core, the cache hierarchy and memory
The P-cluster shares an L2 and an AMX unit. The SLC sits on the memory side of coherence and fills from L2 victims. Latencies are what one core measures.
share the fabric and the memory side
It has its own L1 TLBs.
It has its own L1 TLBs.
It has its own L1 TLBs.
It has its own L1 TLBs.
Its 128 B lines come in two halves.
One core loads 85 GB/s and stores 100 GB/s.
It includes the L1Ds and spares their lines.
Four 3 MiB cachelets give a core 7.5 MiB.
Three way groups power up apart.
It has a register set per core.
The SQ feeds it 2 a clock.
each way between L1 and L2.
~ An L2 TLB and page walkers may sit beside it.
~ E cores may use this L2 while P cores sleep.
It has 4 cores and its own L2.
It has its own clock domain.
It has its own AMX unit.
It shares the SLC and DRAM.
It ramps from idle in 40 to 100 ms.
A core powers up in about 10 us.
A closed loop controller sets performance.
A power estimator throttles vector and AMX issue.
The E-cluster and the GPU also request through the fabric.
The coherence point keeps duplicate L2 tags.
Each cluster has one NoC port.
It has 5 QoS classes and 6 virtual channels.
Device traffic uses a separate PIO network.
It has 4096 sets of 128 B lines.
It sits on the memory side.
Its set index hashes PA bits 7 and up.
Reads and writes share one path.
The DRAM clock scales with demand.
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
